limitations: Driver instruction counts and static latency estimates are not execution measurements.
Timestamp instrumentation adds resolve/copy/readback; it cannot establish ordinary application speed.
Some initial timestamp captures overlapped compiler diagnostic builds.
Compilation allocation counters observe arena backing allocations, not every internal allocation call.
Compilation results are a single diagnostic pair, not a reliable speed claim.
Peak process-tree RSS is not physical GPU residency.
Doppler check covers retained kernels and shapes, not full-model inference.
Browser replacement, installed release qualification, device loss and conformance remain separate.
nextAction: Locate a generated-program cost with a measurable application contribution before selecting another general SPIR-V transformation. Preserve the accepted Vulkan baseline.
